verificationSummary: Editor commit d2290b47a37adc8aee2067ed4e094c6f39350b6c adds an Editor-owned add-node contract builder in src/editor/commands/addNodeContract.ts and focused tests in src/tests/addNodeContract.test.ts. The builder consumes NodeAddPlacementPlan values from the prior placement readiness lane, requires a fresh Core read envelope, preserves documentId and baseRevision from the Editor runtime, and creates Editor-side contract requests for text-block.insert and columns.insert only. text-block.insert requires a caller-owned textBlock payload with valid id, type, props, role, and parsed Core inline children through the Core adapter boundary. columns.insert requires columnCount to be an integer from 1 to 6 and accepts an optional non-empty columnsId. Ready contract plans still return activationStatus blocked with the reason Backend add-node transport is not enabled for Editor runtime yet. The builder blocks stale Core envelopes, blocked placements, disallowed Core runtime child types, missing or invalid text-block payloads, invalid columns counts, and unsupported generic add-node kinds such as table, toc, page-break, divider, and spacer because this Editor contract does not expose repository-owned Core/Backend insert paths for them. Accepted RED evidence: npm run test -- src/tests/addNodeContract.test.ts failed because ../editor/commands/addNodeContract did not exist. GREEN evidence: npm run test -- src/tests/addNodeContract.test.ts passed 1 file and 3 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, 96 test files with 332 tests, and build. The change intentionally does not modify BackendMutationOperation, BackendMutationRequest, FlowDocBackendClient.commitMutation, Backend src/contracts/mutation.ts, Backend capability responses, Core operation semantics, visible add-node UI, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, active text input UI, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; it was not remediated in this lane. After merge, branch editor-add-node-contract-20260830 was deleted and the linked Editor worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 remains detached at d2290b47a37adc8aee2067ed4e094c6f39350b6c because node_modules contains junctions to Core and previous recursive cleanup exposed dependency-link side effects.
